description: This file defines hooks related to user account management in Drupal, including account cancellation, display name alteration, login/logout actions, and permission modifications.

methods.name: hook_user_cancel
methods.description: Handles user account cancellation actions such as unpublishing or anonymizing user content based on the cancellation method.

methods.name: hook_user_cancel_methods_alter
methods.description: Allows modules to modify available account cancellation methods, including adding or removing options and setting access permissions.

methods.name: hook_user_format_name_alter
methods.description: Modifies the display name of a user, e.g., to hide real usernames for privacy.

methods.name: hook_user_login
methods.description: Performs actions when a user logs in, such as prompting timezone configuration.

methods.name: hook_user_logout
methods.description: Records logout events in the database.
